definitions.explanation: The system of pipes that carries water, gas, or other fluids in a building. Also refers to the work of installing or repairing such pipes.

examples.japanese: {配管|はいかん}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めます→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{配|はい} (distribute) + ⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧ (pipe, tube)

Literally "distributing pipes" - the system of pipes that distributes water/gas throughout a building.

TYPES OF {配管|はいかん}:
- ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧{配管|はいかん} - water supply piping
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧{配管|はいかん} - drainage piping
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧{配管|はいかん} - gas piping
- ⟦{空調|くうちょう}→空調：27362_kuuchou⟧{配管|はいかん} - HVAC piping
